target_binding: base_url and cases are supplied by the operator (mission scope.json / target_intake). This manifest ships only the case schema and regression-stub references; it never binds a target.

cases.notes: H2.CL (master plan corpus item): an H2 POST whose headers carry content-length: 0 + transfer-encoding: chunked poisons the desync-switch front-end's pooled backend connection; the next victim's stream returns the smuggled internal-gateway response — a body their route can never produce. Ground truth: the victim-observed anomaly. (v1.22: lab-backed.)

Negative control: the SAME smuggled payload against a conformant front-end (TE stripped, C-L synthesized) must NOT poison — the victim gets exactly what they asked for. A signal here is a false positive and fails the gate. (v1.22: lab-backed.)
